<b>Last Claws</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They were [[Skarr]] who were the last line of defence for [[Skarrsinger Karmelita]], and are only found as enemies in her memory.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Being flying enemies, Last Claws will always attempt to distance themselves diagonally from Hornet, however they may often close in or change their positioning for certain attacks:
* <b>Double Slash:</b> Slashes outwards twice, also hitting slightly behind itself. It will close in on Hornet before using this move if there is distance.
* <b>Divebomb:</b> Holds its spear beneath itself and plunges directly downwards. Only used if Hornet is at least moderately horizontally aligned with it.
* <b>Flying Charge:</b> Charges directly horizontally at Hornet across the arena until it hits a wall. The Last Claw may sometimes preface this move by horizontally distancing itself from Hornet more and vertically aligning itself beforehand.
* <b>Evade:</b> Performs an aerial dash backwards to gain distance from Hornet, often used after missing a move and she's close to it.

Last Claws deal {{Damage|2}} for all spear attacks, but only {{Damage|1}} for contact damage.

== Location ==
Two Last Claws can be found in [[Skarrsinger Karmelita|Skarrsinger Karmelita's]] arena, acting as her last line of defence.

== Trivia ==
* Last Claws do not respond to the [[Needolin]].
*Last Claws have numerous [[Cut Content (Silksong)#Enemy Behaviours|cut]] attacks such as "Throw" and "Block" attacks.
* The body of a Last Claw is found alongside the bodies of various other enemies to the left of [[Gurr the Outcast|Gurr the Outcast's]] boss arena after defeating him. This is notably its only appearance in the present.
** There is another unused sprite of a Last Claw corpse, covered in moss.
